command:
source /tools/common.sh
	CAT_NODE=$(get_db2_head_node)
kubectl exec -it -n ${NAMESPACE}  ${CAT_NODE?} -- bash -c "su - db2inst1 -c \"/db2u/db2u_restore_morph.sh\""
exit $?
containers.name: restore-morph
